revised_prompts:
Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot, template webtoon-shot-v1. Canvas 1536x2048 with 6% safe margin. Extreme close-up, top-down angle, normal lens feel, camera positioned just above Theo’s fingertips, subtle pull-out feeling. Focus on the exact moment gray ash returning through a paper-like blank space becomes warm bread crumbs beside his finger. Leave a long vertical negative space below so the dining-table atmosphere can quietly return.

Subject: Theo Waldhart as a 7-year-old, only a small child’s left hand visible in foreground at left 20%, top 48%, width 50%, height 35%. Loose relaxed small hand, blue-gray sleeve matching reference character outfit, no face, no body. One fingertip gently touches a single warm crumb. Preserve child-sized proportions and the soft blue-gray cuff.

Background/location: Arken-fall-memory transition into present dining table. Use the visual idea from the lower crop of the second reference: dark oak tabletop in stable top view. Layers: Theo’s hand, bread crumbs and last traces of ash, dark oak table. A paper-toned blank transitional space above and through the center where cool gray ash fades into warm beige crumbs. Lighting: warm low table light returning softly.

Visual treatment: clean linework on fingertips and crumbs, concise 2D transition rendering, color shift from cool ash gray to warm beige crumb tones, quiet unresolved determination. Neutral screen direction.

Continuity: entering state adult hand and ledger have turned to ash; leaving state Theo has returned to the table, warm bread crumbs remain beside his finger.

Do not include: speech bubbles, captions, readable text, watermark, signature, duplicate character, magic effects, adult hand, face, full body.
